Arithmetic on quantities:
- PO: 24 units
- Received: 12 (GR-2026-0152A) + 12 (GR-2026-0152B) = 24 units
- Invoiced: earlier 0215/PSG/X/2026 (12 units, same total) + this invoice (12 units) = 24 units total

The total invoiced fits within what was received, and there is a goods receipt (GR-2026-0152B, dated 2026-10-11) covering this later delivery of 12 units.
